name: SUPREME
description: Supplementary files for article "SUPREME: A multi-GPU framework for reproducible image unlearning method evaluation" This record contains the supplementary material for “SUPREME: A Multi-GPU Framework for Reproducible Image Unlearning Method Evaluation”, accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Machine Unlearning and Privacy Preservation (WIPE-OUT 2026), co-located with ECML PKDD 2026. The supplementary document contains Appendices A–D: the SUPREME component registry, the unlearning metric definitions, additional results for Pins Face Recognition, and the ethical considerations. © The Author(s), CC BY-NC 4.0
